varied.source_kind: distinct real X2D FFF images decoded by LibRaw

sequence.source_kind: coherent real photo sequence; not verified interval timelapse or continuous sensor video

calibration: Same-model operator-supplied color matrices, FFF per-shot WB/black/white/crop/orientation. Manufacturer lens/opcode processing not reproduced.
limits: Encoding timers exclude source RAW decoding/file reads and rendering; not sustainable camera frame rates.
RSS is process resident memory, not total live malloc capacity or camera DMA budget.
16-bit input is reduced through the stock 12-bit log-domain transform and lossy preset.
Private sources, timestamps, device identifiers, photos, movies and individual image hashes are excluded.
Published evidence is an aggregate of private operator inputs; reproduce mechanics with synthetic test or supply independently authorized images.
